units.characteristics: the heart's plans vs the LORD's establishing (human planning + divine sovereignty)
units.gist: CORNERSTONE thread - 'the plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD'; 'commit your work to the LORD and your plans will be established'; 'the heart of man plans his way, but the LORD establishes his steps'; the lot decided by the LORD

units.characteristics: the self pure in its own eyes; the LORD weighs the spirit
units.gist: GEM - 'all the ways of a man are pure in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the spirit' (self-blindness vs divine assay, w/ 21:2, Ps 139)

units.characteristics: pride vs lowliness
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall'; 'better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor than divide spoil with the proud'; arrogant heart an abomination

units.characteristics: fear of the LORD turns from evil; trust discovers good
units.gist: 'by the fear of the LORD one turns away from evil'; 'blessed is he who trusts in the LORD'

units.characteristics: the heart makes the speech; gracious words sweet to the soul
units.gist: 'the heart of the wise makes his speech judicious'; 'gracious words are like a honeycomb, sweetness to the soul and health to the body' (speech as the heart's outflow)

units.characteristics: self-mastery - ruling one's spirit
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'whoever is slow to anger is better than the mighty, and he who rules his spirit than he who takes a city' (the conquest of the self, w/ Ps self-government)

units.characteristics: self-deception - the way that seems right
units.gist: 'there is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death' (the self misreading its path; = 14:12)

units.characteristics: the LORD tests hearts
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'the crucible is for silver, the furnace for gold, and the LORD tests hearts' (the assayed heart, w/ Ps 7:9, 139, 26:2)

units.characteristics: the felt heart - joyful vs crushed spirit
units.gist: CORNERSTONE of the felt-interior - 'a joyful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones' (w/ 15:13, 18:14)

units.characteristics: the depth a rebuke reaches in the understanding
units.gist: 'a rebuke goes deeper into a man of understanding than a hundred blows into a fool' (teachability - the receptive interior)

units.characteristics: restraint of words; the cool spirit
units.gist: 'whoever restrains his words has knowledge, and he who has a cool spirit is a man of understanding'; even a fool who keeps silent is thought wise

units.characteristics: love that covers; the friend for adversity
units.gist: 'whoever covers an offense seeks love'; 'a friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity' (relational love, w/ 10:12)

units.characteristics: the tongue - deep waters, life and death
units.gist: CORNERSTONE speech thread - 'the words of a man's mouth are deep waters, the fountain of wisdom a bubbling brook'; the whisperer's words 'go down into the inner parts'; 'DEATH AND LIFE are in the power of the tongue'

units.characteristics: the name of the LORD as refuge vs wealth as imagined refuge
units.gist: GEM - 'the name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous runs into it and is safe' vs 'a rich man's wealth is his strong city... in his IMAGINATION' (true vs imagined refuge, w/ Ps 61/18)

units.characteristics: the haughty heart before the fall; humility before honour
units.gist: 'before destruction a man's heart is haughty, but humility comes before honour' (pride/humility thread)

units.characteristics: the unbearable crushed spirit
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'a man's spirit will endure sickness, but a crushed spirit who can bear?' (the spirit as the load-bearing self; w/ 17:22, 15:13)

units.characteristics: hearing before answering; the seeking heart
units.gist: 'a fool takes no pleasure in understanding, only in expressing his opinion'; 'if one answers before he hears, it is folly'; 'an intelligent heart acquires knowledge, the ear of the wise seeks it'

units.characteristics: getting sense = loving one's own soul
units.gist: GEM - 'whoever gets sense loves his own soul; he who keeps understanding will discover good' (wisdom as self-love/self-care)

units.characteristics: slow to anger; overlooking an offense
units.gist: 'good sense makes one slow to anger, and it is his glory to overlook an offense'; the man of great wrath pays the penalty (self-rule thread)

units.characteristics: the heart that rages at God for its own folly
units.gist: GEM - 'when a man's folly brings his way to ruin, his heart rages against the LORD' (mis-directed blame; the self indicting God for self-caused ruin)

units.characteristics: fear of the LORD - rests satisfied
units.gist: 'the fear of the LORD leads to life, and whoever has it RESTS SATISFIED; he will not be visited by harm' (fear -> contented rest, w/ Ps)

units.characteristics: the heart's many plans vs the LORD's purpose
units.gist: 'many are the plans in the mind of a man, but it is the purpose of the LORD that will stand' (heart-sovereignty thread, w/ 16:9)

units.characteristics: what is desired in a man is steadfast love
units.gist: 'what is desired in a man is steadfast love (chesed), and a poor man is better than a liar' (the loyal-love that is prized in a person)

units.characteristics: the spirit as the lamp of the LORD searching the innermost
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'the spirit of man is the lamp of the LORD, searching all his innermost parts' (the self lit and searched to its depths, w/ Ps 139)

units.characteristics: the heart's deep, drawable purpose
units.gist: GEM - 'the purpose in a man's heart is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out' (the opacity + drawability of the inner life)

units.characteristics: who can say 'I have made my heart pure'?
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'Who can say, I have made my heart pure; I am clean from my sin?' (the confession of the heart's uncleansability by the self, w/ Ps 19:12, 51)

units.characteristics: not repaying evil; waiting on the LORD
units.gist: CORNERSTONE - 'Do not say, I will repay evil; WAIT for the LORD, and he will deliver you' (entrustment of the grievance, w/ Ps 37, 109:4, Rom 12:19)

units.characteristics: the heart in the LORD's hand; the weighed heart
units.gist: CORNERSTONE heart-sovereignty - 'the king's heart is a stream of water in the hand of the LORD; he turns it wherever he will'; 'every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the heart'; no wisdom avails against the LORD

units.characteristics: haughty eyes and a proud heart as sin
units.gist: 'haughty eyes and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, are sin' (pride thread)

units.characteristics: the soul's desire - the wicked craves evil; the sluggard's craving kills
units.gist: 'the SOUL of the wicked desires evil'; 'the desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labour; all day long he CRAVES and craves, but the righteous gives'; loving pleasure/wine = poverty

units.characteristics: keeping the mouth keeps the self from trouble
units.gist: 'whoever keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps himself out of trouble' (speech-restraint self-preservation)

units.characteristics: the wicked's bold face vs the upright's considered ways
units.gist: 'a wicked man puts on a bold face, but the upright gives thought to his ways' (bravado vs self-examination)

units.characteristics: humility + fear of the LORD rewarded
units.gist: 'the reward for humility and fear of the LORD is riches and honour and life' (humility+fear thread)

units.characteristics: loving purity of heart
units.gist: 'he who loves purity of heart, and whose speech is gracious, will have the king as his friend' (the loved clean heart + gracious speech)

units.characteristics: the prudent foresees danger; guarding the soul
units.gist: 'the prudent sees danger and hides himself, but the simple go on and suffer'; 'whoever guards his soul will keep far from thorns and snares'

units.characteristics: receptivity - words kept within, that trust may be in the LORD
units.gist: the opening of the Thirty Sayings - 'incline your ear... apply your heart... keep them within you... that your TRUST may be in the LORD' (the aim of instruction = trust)

units.characteristics: formation by company - avoiding the wrathful
units.gist: 'make no friendship with a man given to anger... lest you learn his ways and entangle yourself' (the self shaped by its company; anger is catching)
